shadcn.note: See README.md, "Tokens and rules": give the component a variant or size rather than restyling it; use the type-* roles, the spacing scale or a named token from src/tokens.css; dynamic values are custom properties.

paths.message: Import the part you use (`@base-ui/react/<part>`), not the root barrel, so an app bundles only that part.
